name: Dyersburg State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Non-resident (out-of-state) tuition & fees from official DSCC FY26-27 (2026-2027) Fee Schedule PDF (dscc.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/DSCC-FY26-27-Fee-Schedules.pdf): full-time 12 credit hours = $4,282.00/semester total tuition & fees x 2 = $8,564/year. Matches basis of in-state figure (in-state 12hr = $2,542/sem = $5,084/yr, equals known in-state).
